title: Soft Body Avocado Slingshot Arena
description: A ShaderBall sits on a pedestal as a target while soft-body avocados are launched at it via a slingshot mechanic. The user drags to aim and release avocados that deform on impact, accumulating hits to progressively dent and displace the ShaderBall through simulated soft-body physics.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a soft-body avocado slingshot arena. Load Avocado.glb and ShaderBall.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the ShaderBall centered at (0, 0, -8) on a flat ground plane, scaled to roughly 2 units tall. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 3, 6) looking toward the ShaderBall. Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light from (5, 10, 5) with shadows enabled. Implement these interactions: (1) Click and drag downward/sideways from a launch zone at screen bottom to define slingshot direction and power, shown by a visible elastic line using a BufferGeometry line. (2) On release, spawn a cloned Avocado at the launch point scaled to 0.4 units and propel it toward the ShaderBall with velocity proportional to drag distance (clamped between 2-15 units). (3) Simulate soft-body deformation on the avocado by modifying its mesh vertices on collision: detect proximity to ShaderBall bounding sphere, then squash vertices along the collision normal by 20-40% using a falloff function, and slightly expand perpendicular axes to conserve volume. (4) On each hit, apply a small displacement and wobble rotation to the ShaderBall using damped spring physics (stiffness 50, damping 0.8) to simulate it absorbing impact. (5) Track hit count in an on-screen HTML overlay. After 3 hits, the ShaderBall should visually crack by darkening its material and adding emissive red lines. (6) After 6 cumulative hits, the ShaderBall shatters: hide the original mesh and spawn 8-12 fragment boxes with the ShaderBall's material that fly outward with physics. (7) A reset button restores the scene. Validate that drag distance must exceed 30 pixels to fire, maximum 10 avocados on screen at once (remove oldest), and the ShaderBall wobble must settle before registering the next hit. Use requestAnimationFrame for the game loop with delta-time integration. Add OrbitControls but disable them during slingshot drag.
